description: DELIBERATELY WRONG copy used by test-shared-fixtures-break.sh. ShortName.of: the name trimmed (Unicode White_Space, as TextNormalizer.trimmed), cut before its first ", " (U+002C then U+0020 only) and trimmed again. When the trimmed name has no ", " or the cut leaves nothing, the result is the whole trimmed name. Display only: a stored name is never rewritten. BDPM names read 'NAME DOSE, pharmaceutical form'; a decimal comma ('0,05 %') has no space after it and is never cut.

cases.name: a BDPM name loses its pharmaceutical form
a decimal comma is not a cut
a name that is only a decimal comma is kept whole
the cut is at the first separator
cases.input: SMECTA 3 g FRAISE, poudre pour suspension buvable, en sachet

cases.name: a comma without a space is not a separator
a space before the comma is trimmed away
a comma then a no-break space is not a separator
a leading separator leaves nothing, so the whole name is kept
a leading separator after spaces is kept whole and trimmed
a manually entered name is shortened the same way
